integrity: Exact transfer-matrix and Newton-identity checker supplied; the all-length theorem follows from a finite certified matrix identity and combinatorial orbit identities, not from finite data extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Only four-letter complement alphabets and block-two cyclic periodic avoidance are treated; lengths one through three use periodic extension rather than physical deletion. No error-correcting-code optimality or general-q formula is claimed.
title: Exact cyclic reverse-complement-duplication avoidance zeta function for the DNA alphabet
